# Window Film Philadelphia

> Professional window film and window tinting installation for homes and businesses across Philadelphia and the Delaware Valley. Locally owned and operated since 2008.

## About
Window Film Philadelphia is a Scottish Window Tinting company providing residential, commercial, government, and specialty window film installation. We serve Philadelphia, the Main Line, South Jersey, Montgomery County, Bucks County, Delaware County, and Chester County.

## Services
- Residential Window Film: home tinting, UV protection, privacy film, safety film, decorative film
- Commercial Window Film: solar control, anti-graffiti, safety and security, decorative and branding
- Government & Public: government buildings, schools, museums, churches, mass transit
- Specialty: bomb blast protection, ballistic resistant film, bird strike film, exterior refinishing

## Benefits
- Energy savings: reduce cooling costs by blocking up to 80% of solar heat
- UV protection: block 99% of harmful UV rays
- Privacy: one-way daytime privacy without losing natural light
- Glare reduction: reduce glare by up to 87%
- Safety: hold shattered glass together during break-ins and storms

## Products
3M, LLumar, Madico, Vista, Huper Optik, C-Bond, HD Clear, Hanita Coatings, Solyx, Solar Gard, Casper
